decisions.reason: The church-motif music box extends the firm's established seasonal line and fits its announced move to blend tradition with technology, and with only one year of seasonal sales any weak results can still be put down to temporary causes, so management will keep it.

The nativity stable is central to the firm's traditional Christmas woodcraft identity and is built in its own workshops, so dropping it would write off sunk design and production effort and contradict its core offer.

The modern incense smoker carries the firm's visible commitment to contemporary designs on traditional forms, and after a single season disappointing sales can still be attributed to temporary factors, which favours persistence.
